description: This file defines the Zebra_DatePicker plugin, a JavaScript/jQuery-based date picker widget with customizable options and UI components.

classes.name: Zebra_DatePicker
classes.description: Main class implementing the date picker widget with methods for showing, hiding, setting date, destroying, and updating the widget.

methods.name: clear_date
methods.description: Clears the selected date in the date picker.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the date picker instance and associated DOM elements, unbinds events.

methods.name: set_date
methods.description: Sets the date in the input field and updates the widget.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the date picker settings and UI based on new options.
